title: Attend While God's Exalted Son
description: Attend While God's Exalted Son in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 130, headed “The new creation”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: At-tend while God's ex-alt-ed Son Doth his own glo-ries shew; "Be-hold I sit up-on my throne Cre-a-ting all things new.

lines: "None but the new-born heirs of grace
From my old state of sin;
O make my soul alive to thee,
Renew mine eyes, and form mine ears,
Give me new passions, joys and fears,
And turn the stone to flesh.
Far from the regions of the dead,
From sin, and earth, and hell,
In the new-world that grace has made

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
